all_page_pass.method: All 114 pages of the promoted artifact were rendered at 45 dpi into one ordered overview and inspected once for page geometry, centering, clipping, malformed mathematics, accidental blanks, and density discontinuities.

targeted_pass.finding: The final cover shows exact source credit, CC BY 4.0, independent adaptation status, and exact model provenance; a dense mathematical page and the final bibliography page are readable and unclipped.
